estimates.name: Contingent Consideration
estimates.t: We estimate the fair value of contingent consideration through valuation models that incorporate a DCF model related to the achievement of a certain specified milestone.

estimates.name: Valuation of Intangible Assets
estimates.t: When significant identifiable intangible assets are acquired, we engage an independent third-party valuation firm to assist in determining the fair values of these assets as of the acquisition date.
